Practice

Advocacy

Political and issue advocacy programs structured to operate confidently across jurisdictions.

III.

Our approach

← All practice areas

TPLG helps corporations, nonprofit organizations, trade associations, advocacy groups and political professionals design and execute sophisticated political and issue advocacy programs. We advise on the legal frameworks governing communications, grassroots activity, independent expenditures, political giving, coalition activity and other efforts to influence public policy and the political process.

For organizations operating nationally, we help identify when activity triggers campaign finance, lobbying, disclosure, pay-to-play or other regulatory requirements and develop structures that can function across multiple jurisdictions. For political technology companies, platforms, payment processors and other businesses entering the political marketplace, we apply established political laws to new products, technologies and business models.

Our role is not simply to identify restrictions. We work with clients to understand what they are trying to accomplish, contextualize the legal risk and develop practical, compliant paths forward.

Political law counsel nationwide.
